sentences.text: (BY SMT. GIRIJA S. HIREMATH, HCGP FOR R1)

THIS CRIMINAL PETITION IS FILED U/S 482 OF CR.P.C.
SEEKING TO QUASH THE FIR REGISTERED / FILED AGAINST THE PETITIONERS ACCUSED NO.1 TO 4 PENDING ON THE FILE II JMFC AT BELAGAVI BEARING MAHILA POLICE STATION CRIME NO.69/2019 FOR THE OFFENCE PUNISHABLE UNDER SEC.498(A), 323, 506 R/W SEC.34 OF IPC.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER Case called twice.
None present on behalf of the petitioners even in the second round of calling of cases.
The present petition is filed in the year 2020 in respect of offences U/sec.498A, 323, 506 r/w Section 34 of IPC.
Office objections are not complied despite granting sufficient opportunity.

Hence,
petition is dismissed for non-prosecution.

Sd/-
